translation: ⟨the⟩ gazer from me, and I will ⟨be⟩ covered in darkness before I go, and ⟨am⟩ no more.

tokens.rationale: from השע (to gaze); understood as 'the one who gazes' with definite article implied

tokens.english: and I will ⟨be⟩ covered in darkness
tokens.rationale: rare verb; from בלג (to cover, as with darkness); future tense first common singular with waw consecutive
Qal imperfect first common singular of הלך ('to go')
אין ('nothing, not') + suffix נִי ('me'); literally 'and I am not'
